info.name: FleetMon API Reference Basic Vessel Data Vessels Nearby API

params.name: vessel_id
params.description: FleetMon identifier for maritime objects like vessels

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius around the requested vessel in meter. Default and maximum radius is 2500 meter.

params.name: request_limit_info
params.description: If `true` some extra attributes will be added to the response informing about usage and limits of this endpoint.
